name: Michelle
source:
Michelle Davenport is the one who oversees the Time Tenshi's missions into history, and while she rarely travels through the Time Window herself, she keeps a watchful eye on the progress of each operation from the laboratory's control room.

She comes from the USA and has beautiful long, red hair with piercing yellow eyes. She's stern and serious - she's never seen without her trademark cane - but she also has a softer side, even if it doesn't come out that often.

In her downtime she practices ballet, a hobby she actually keeps well-hidden from her fellow scientists, and enjoys iced tea. The Time Window facility doesn't seem to have a Time Suit for her on record in its data banks... but Michelle also has a casual outfit in the game which will be used for more social occasions, and maybe even for a date!

"I also do my best to make sure that nobody steps out of line here."

- From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/silvercow/time-tenshi-time-travelling-anime-visual-novel/posts/2738469]Time Tenshi Kickstarter update #5[/url]
